With Austin's diverse underground synth scene starting to boil over (see: Neon Indian's world domination, Silent Diane's new single on Matador imprint True Panther, //TENSE// early EBM shocks and Sleep ∞ Over's debut on Hippos In Tanks), SURVIVE is creeping up, not far behind. 2) SURVIVE is a japanese Metal/Hardcore band formed in Kashiwa, Japan in 1998. perplexity.description:
Survive's HD015, released in 2012 on Holodeck Records, is the debut full-length album by the Austin-based electronic quartet. The album is a foundational work in the synthwave and minimal electronic genres, characterized by its atmospheric textures, analog synthesizers, and evocative, cinematic soundscapes. Tracks such as "Deserted Skies," "Floating Cube," and "Omniverse" showcase the band's mastery of mood and repetition, blending ambient passages with rhythmic pulses that evoke both nostalgia and unease.

HD015 occupies a pivotal place in Survive's discography, marking their transition from cassette and EP releases to a full-length statement. It established their signature sound, which would later influence their acclaimed work on film soundtracks, including Stranger Things. While the album did not achieve mainstream commercial success, it received strong critical praise within the underground electronic music scene for its immersive quality and technical precision. Its reputation has grown over time, solidifying HD015 as a landmark release in modern synth-driven electronic music.
